about: MPFB2's game_engine rig as humanform's scaffold leaves it: renamed to rig-anything's names (Root -> root, pelvis -> spine, neck_01 -> spine.004, head -> spine.005, fingers f_index.01.L ...). The root lies on the floor and carries no skin; the arms rest bent and the stance is straddled.

rest.about: Ranges over two bodies built by humanform.pipeline (a curvy 1.70 m woman, a heavy 1.82 m man), before bake. forearm_bend_deg: upper_arm to forearm; stance_half_width_share: half the foot-head separation over rig height; ankle_over_hip_separation: foot-head separation over thigh-head separation.
